raised: The coloured-number key ('123 מקמר / חושב / הזנתם') and the word 'מקמר' are confusing
The basic vs extended fee packages, and what they would cost, are not understood
The calculator assumes a 5% return for an account that pays almost nothing, and nothing suggests trying 0%
Unclear whether the calculator shows 'בכסף של היום' or 'בשקלים של העתיד'
The BANK-20/BANK-23/BANK-15 tags mean nothing to the reader
The 'כסף נכנס ויוצא' section was partly cut off between screenshots
The cost table gives no numbers, only 'לפי התעריפון של הגורם המציע'
The dark red strip 'שאלה פתוחה: TXI OQ11' looks like a warning but is unclear
Worry that Israel has no deposit insurance and the 250,000 ₪ protection is only a proposal
'מה האתר לקח בחשבון' with its padlocks and 'חסום' reads like internal notes and should go
The terms table seems to appear twice
The chart colours (green area, pink line, pale line) have no legend
The deposits figure 62,681 doesn't match 10,000 + 500/month for 10 years (70,000)
The 'חוקים וכללים' column in the cost table is empty
Unclear whether the 'מזומן שקלי' chip can be clicked
No figure for how much is lost each year by keeping money at 0% while prices rise
No actual current interest rates for deposits or money market funds to compare
No guidance on how much to keep in the current account
Unclear whether a money market fund is protected if the fund or bank fails
No guidance on what to say to the bank
The 'כסף נכנס ויוצא' cards about moving shares are irrelevant and could go
Parts of 'למה משתמשים בזה' and the tax cards were lost between screenshots

problems.why: The reader is only unsure which money view is shown (item 4) and confused by the 62,681 sum (item 13), but never says the 'בשקלים של העתיד' figures ignore inflation and are wrong.
